subject: door
title: 门缝看月亮的小猫
alt: 薄荷雨夜配色：浅银灰小猫从半开的门后探出圆脸和小爪，看向一弯月亮与两颗小星星
generation: 内置 ImageGen；先制作草莓主题母图，再以同主题母图编辑配色

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, color-palette variant. This image is the approved finished kitten artwork and the exact edit target. Change ONLY its illustration color palette as described below. Preserve the precise kitten identity, face, fur markings, expression, pose, silhouette, anatomy, linework, object shapes, sizes, positions, entire composition, plain paper, existing white margins, canvas size and exact 4:3 aspect ratio. Do not add, remove, shrink, move or redraw objects. Keep the current clean cute cel-anime illustration with thin clear lines, flat fills and simple pale shadows. Do not introduce paper texture, grain, brown/yellow aged wash, oil paint, watercolor, blur, haze, text, border, UI, signature or watermark. The background and existing paper margins stay clean near-white, not tinted.
Palette replacement: Mint rainy-night palette: change the main pink door/blanket/pencil surfaces to pale mint green, use cool clean white and a little desaturated blue for secondary accents, and replace warm sunset-yellow decorations with soft cool pale-blue/white accents. The kitten remains very pale silver-gray with pink inner ears/nose and exactly the same dark eyes.
